name: 해방된 할파스
user_authorization: Production image tools authorized; no images or image links in main chat. One private new-role correction attempt.
corrective_reason: Existing NW source is front-left instead of absolute rear-left. New NW walk uses only verified correct NORTH rear models plus original portrait. No previous wrong NW source is referenced.
prompt:
Create ONE production game animation sprite sheet: SIX distinct WALK poses of the SAME armored winged boss Halpas. References: image1 is the original identity portrait; images2 and3 are the CORRECT NORTH/BACK WALK and IDLE model. Use these exact rear-view assets as the construction model. This is a NEW NORTHWEST WALK commission, turning that existing north-facing model ONLY45 degrees toward screen-UP-LEFT. Do not turn to a front view. Original portrait supplies materials/equipment only, never copy its front-facing pose.

ABSOLUTE NW ORIENTATION IN EVERY FIGURE: We stand behind and slightly to the character's RIGHT, viewing his BACK-LEFT direction of travel toward the UPPER-LEFT of the image, AWAY from camera. Render a rear three-quarter view, predominantly BACK armor/spine, back of helmet, back/underside of cape. Helmet points upper-left away from us. Shoulder and pelvic axes, knees, toes and forward leg extension all align with travel UPPER-LEFT. Nose/face may only be a tiny far upper-left profile glimpse: never show a face or a front chest. The original skull/sun ornament on front breastplate MUST BE HIDDEN, because it is on the opposite side of the body. No visible front skull chestplate. The back must retain the narrow articulated gold-trimmed dark spine plates clearly shown in NORTH references. Do not merely aim a front-view sword diagonally upper-left; the WHOLE BODY is a genuine rear view.

Preserve EXACT character identity and anatomy from NORTH references: black-and-gold armor and helmet/horns, burgundy torn cape attached on the same established anatomical side, TWO solid crystalline purple feather-fan wings with gold roots, one broad purple crystalline sword in the SAME ANATOMICAL RIGHT HAND as NORTH images. No hand swap/mirror, no new weapons, horns, feathers, limbs or wing pairs. The near/far wing roots rotate with the back naturally; one wing is foreshortened rather than duplicated symmetrically. The original portrait tiny front chest ornament remains on front and MUST NOT appear on back. Maintain same high-detail material rendering, armor proportions and elevated orthographic game camera.

ACTUAL WALK, not an idle hover: all6 poses have visibly changing hip/knee/ankle support and limb articulation, plus coordinated wing/cape followthrough. Frame0 first foot plants forward along UP-LEFT with opposite leg trailing/back; frame1 body passes over that supporting foot, other knee bends to swing; frame2 opposite leg swings forward while first pushes off; frame3 OPPOSITE FOOT plants forward UP-LEFT with first leg trailing, clearly different contact from frame0; frame4 body passes over second planted foot and first leg swings; frame5 first leg recovers toward first contact. Use strong readable alternating legs and different knee/foot silhouettes. Armor joints remain connected. Wings subtly flex for balance, cape lags, free arm counter-swings and weapon held safely to side. Maintain same rear-left NW heading during every contact/passing/swing phase. Camera and facing never rotate during cycle.

OUTPUT:1024x1536 transparent PNG, EXACTLY2 COLUMNS by3 ROWS, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Exactly6 complete figures only, one per512x512cell. Scale each ENTIRE body+both wings+cape+weapon+horns into a central320x320 square in its cell, leaving at least96px transparent margin on ALL sides of every cell. Empty gutters and separation are essential. If necessary make the whole figures smaller uniformly; never crop any body/weapon/wing tip and never change body scale between frames. No overlapping figures, no touching silhouettes, each complete fullbody is an isolated cutout. All6 use same pixel scale.

Background fully transparent alpha0, including between limbs and wings. Shading stays INSIDE solids. No floor, shadow, contact shadow, halo, glow outside crystals, bloom, fog, mist, effects, particles, motion trails, detached fragments, blur, grid, labels, text or borders. Crisp hard-edged detailed sprites with only1-2px antialiasing. The most important checks are GENUINE REAR-LEFT BACK VIEW TOWARD UPPER-LEFT in ALL6, hidden front chest/face, exact established wings/equipment/hand, and readable alternating WALK foot support.
